report.reason: writeReport creates directory then opens/appends actual markdown file, writes verdict and JSON run, closes file. podman_fixture.reason: installHelper writes a PATH shim executing current test executable with selected helper root. Helper reads inherited fd3 secret pipe, writes job ownership marker, emits malformed/oversized JSON and hangs, or handles inspect/exists/stop/rm. Cleanup barrier coordinates helper processes via .stopped-* files; failures and ownership are synthetic. Read only; no helper executed or classified for original-count credit.

containers.reason: Production runContainers calls container; os.Pipe and exec.CommandContext launch PATH shim as child process. Stdout scanner/JSON validation kills malformed child before Wait. Deferred cleanup detaches cancellation then concurrently invokes inspect/stop/rm child commands, checks label and joins failures. Tests read filesystem markers changed by those children. This is real OS-process/pipe/filesystem integration with a fake Podman endpoint; no containers, OCI, Vault, SSH or real load generator service.
